genuineGap.finding: The detached signature covered only the artifact digest. Manifest metadata, signing-key identity and signing time were not cryptographically bound, and no key-rotation or revocation policy existed.
genuineGap.risk: A valid artifact and signature could be replayed inside altered update metadata; a compromised or retired key had no fail-closed revocation path.

externalBoundaries: Production updater keys and code-signing certificates are absent.
No installer signing, installation, deployment or publication is authorized.
